name: Achievement: Adeptal Valley
description:
Namecard style.
...After that, the fish sank to the bottom of the lake, and the snake was split into several pieces. The remaining beasts waited on mountains, rivers, and moon, awaiting their silent answer.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Chenyu's Splendor."

name: Achievement: All-Seeing
description:
Namecard style.
The gaze of a traveler looks upon all like a light, and your impression of things will someday resurface in your mind in vivid, intense color.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series V"

name: Achievement: Blaze
description:
Namecard style.
After the flame that once represented light, heat, and wisdom became corroded by the tenebrous dark, the only thing that yet belonged to the imprisoned titan was its inextinguishable will to fight.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series X"

name: Achievement: Bowmaster
description:
Namecard style.
Draw that bowstring taut!
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Marksmanship"

name: Achievement: Challenger
description:
Namecard style.
Even if you're just going out to get a single dandelion, there will be obstacles in your path. But you love a challenge, don't you?
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series I"

name: Achievement: Challenger II
description:
Namecard style.
That which awaits at the end of the challenges is...
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series II"

name: Achievement: Challenger III
description:
Namecard style.
Finally, a worthy opponent! Our battle will be legendary!
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger - Series III"

name: Achievement: Chasm
description:
Namecard style.
Where once miners industriously delved and tunneled, now all is silent. Only the Glazed Sand Crystal and marrows of stone, both millennia-old, still give off any brilliance.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Chasmlighter"

name: Achievement: Cliffhanger
description:
Namecard style.
They say that storytellers love their cliffhangers — but you? You've heard it all before.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Stone Harbor's Nostalgia: Series I"

name: Achievement: Colors of the Rainbow
description:
Namecard style.
Light can refract into countless colors, but people stop at seven because they're lazy to count. Perhaps the elements are like that, too.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Elemental Specialist: Series I"

name: Achievement: Deep & Dark
description:
Namecard style.
The deeper you delve, the more secrets you shall uncover.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Domains and Spiral Abyss: Series I"

name: Achievement: Endpoint
description:
Namecard style.
The orbits of the true stars are traced in myriad rings across the night sky. A sea of blossom awaits the return of a single flower, anticipating the day when both hearts and petals shall become soft and tender.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series V"

name: Achievement: Explorer
description:
Namecard style.
After all your wanderings throughout the world, do not forget the reason why you first set out.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series I"

name: Achievement: Far-Sighted
description:
Namecard style.
The traveler once stood atop the town, gazing toward the distant horizon, confident that the far-off sights within view would one day become milestones in the journey ahead.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series VI"

name: Achievement: Fated Encounter
description:
Namecard style.
One day, our encounter at this moment shall shine like a star of reminiscence in our hearts.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series III"

name: Achievement: Feline Fortune
description:
Namecard style.
You want to know what the future holds? Then stay here and sit tight. Let this little kitty resist the urge to knock the crystal ball onto the ground, and steal the secrets of fate for you.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Imaginarium Theater: The Second Folio"

name: Achievement: Fighting Spirit
description:
Namecard style.
Even if one was to lose their physical form and find themselves trapped in the cold depths of some ghostly spring, the will to fight on shall never fade away.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Duelist: Series II"

name: Achievement: Full Bloom
description:
Namecard style.
Gather ye then soil from all corners of the universe, and from it may countless flowers grow.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "A Realm Beyond: Series III"

name: Achievement: Gate
description:
Namecard style.
What encounters lie on the other side of this door?
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series II"

name: Achievement: Hero
description:
Namecard style.
Your hero's journey began before you knew it, but it's the experiences that really made it special.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "The Hero's Journey"

name: Achievement: Hill Dwellers
description:
Namecard style.
The hilichurls were dubbed the "hill devils." But a certain young girl named Musk insists on calling them the "hill dwellers."
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Olah!: Series I"

name: Achievement: Infinitum
description:
Namecard style.
"Oh, Khvarena in your endless forms, protect this imperiled land. The blights and glories of the earthly realm are naught but the illusion of existing seeds."
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Blessed Hamada"

name: Achievement: Invoker
description:
Namecard style.
"In this village, no one can defeat me!"
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Genius Invokation TCG"

name: Achievement: Lord of the Night
description:
Namecard style.
How can restless thoughts be calmed? In this land, the only way is battle!
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Duelist: Series I"

name: Achievement: Mariner
description:
Namecard style.
The hands of travelers have touched ten thousand streams. They all flow from the same font of the world's waters, and all return to the same sea.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series IV"

name: Achievement: Mirrored Dreams
description:
Namecard style.
"A millennium of obsession and tragic yearning has long been lost in the sandstorms of those blazing nights. But the eternal verdant oasis of her dreams is, in all likelihood, as tender as it was at the first..."
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series VI"

name: Achievement: Nails
description:
Namecard style.
"Wait, if these fish can't be eaten, then why are we hammering these nails into fishhooks?" "Oh, you wouldn't understand."
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Teyvat Fishing Guide: Series I"

name: Achievement: Orbits
description:
Namecard style.
"O Almighty Sovereign, the Universitas Magistrorum has provided the predictions you requested: The two stars have been captured by the world's gravity... After a lengthy orbital period, today their paths shall intertwine once more."
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series IV"

name: Achievement: Perpetual
description:
Namecard style.
"No one hears the dream that shattered between the conches and the gears. Only the tireless mechanical dancer still queries the echoes of the past day and night with its every elegant step."
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series VIII"

name: Achievement: Poetic Pages
description:
Namecard style.
The dreams someone weaves into being are false, but they nonetheless point toward something real. There must be an eternity forged from "memory" at the end of this path.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Imaginarium Theater: The First Folio"

name: Achievement: Repertoire
description:
Namecard style.
Perhaps a melody may exist that collects and contains all the wondrous music in the world. Surging heartbeats mark the musical phrase, anxious thoughts form brief rests, and within the notes lie all things — laughter, tears, forgotten dreams, and dancing raindrops...
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Repertoire of Myriad Melodies"

name: Achievement: Reunion
description:
Namecard style.
We shall meet again someday.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series I"

name: Achievement: Roaming
description:
Namecard style.
Every journey and memory is a unique miracle that only belongs to the traveler.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series III"

name: Achievement: Seven Lights
description:
Namecard style.
Anyone can play a tune that belongs just to them, and like the dew upon grass, can reflect the seven lights of heaven.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Elemental Specialist: Series II"

name: Achievement: Snowy Land
description:
Namecard style.
You've heard many stories about Snezhnaya. What does it look like in your mind's eye?
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Snezhnaya Does Not Believe in Tears: Series I"

name: Achievement: Snowy Summit
description:
Namecard style.
A draconian peak must be scaled.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Visitors on the Icy Mountain"

name: Achievement: Stone Dragon
description:
Namecard style.
Our journey among the precipices.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series IV"

name: Achievement: Tea Time
description:
Namecard style.
The days and months pass within the teapot.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "A Realm Beyond: Series I"

name: Achievement: Thunderclap
description:
Namecard style.
Listen to the sound that comes from the clouds. That is its resentful rage, and its tiny wish.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series V"

name: Achievement: Time Apart
description:
Namecard style.
After ten thousand winters come ten thousand springs anew. After ten thousand partings, ten thousand reunions, too. The past has slipped away. Yet tomorrow holds the promise of you.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series VI"

name: Achievement: Tranquil Peace
description:
Namecard style.
If ever the day comes when all worldly conflicts can finally be put to rest, then even the gods of night themselves may drift off into peaceful slumber.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Duelist: Series III"

name: Achievement: Transient Twilight
description:
Namecard style.
"I will forget the flowers of yesteryear, the daylight, the rain. I ask that you remember in my stead, in this nascent world, and hold to that lost dream."
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series VII"

name: Achievement: Traversal
description:
Namecard style.
A traveler shall experience ten thousand tales, and each shall form a part of the traveler's soul.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series II"

name: Achievement: Vacation Home
description:
Namecard style.
The world is wide under the eaves.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "A Realm Beyond: Series II"

name: Achievement: Virtuoso
description:
Namecard style.
After mastering these skills, you may just find that you can get by just fine without engaging in battle. If you are without any commission to complete, that is.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "The Art of Adventure"

name: Achievement: Whalewrangler
description:
Namecard style.
This time, Tartaglia fought this entity for a long time, though he remained unable to defeat it. Hunting the same whale thrice is considered unlucky, but he will not give up. That said, it will be a long while before the creature fully recovers.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series IX"

name: Aino: Whoopsie Ducksie
description:
Namecard style.
When a "Cool Your Jets Ducky" is overheating, does Aino throw out another Ducky to cool its jets, or does she just say "Whoopsie Ducksie" and leave it at that?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Aino

name: Albedo: Sun Blossom
description:
Namecard style.
Allow me to bear witness to this miracle.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Albedo

name: Album: The Stellar Moments
description:
Namecard style.
We parted in one melody and reunited in another.

name: Alhaitham: Enlightenment
description:
Namecard style.
"The only things researchers should abide by are debates and dialectics. Only by questioning everything at all times can one avoid falling into prejudice."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Alhaitham

name: Aloy: Dawn
description:
Namecard style.
"Everything I do is in the service of life, not death."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Aloy

name: Amber: Bunny
description:
Namecard style.
"It's Baron Bunny!"
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Amber

name: Arlecchino: Edict
description:
Namecard style.
"Father" laid down the harsh strictures of the House of the Hearth, and some of these seem almost unreasonable. Those familiar with her can use these rules to trace the outline of the ideals she so rarely speaks of.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Arlecchino

name: Baizhu: Relief
description:
Namecard style.
Sincerity begets longevity.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Baizhu

name: Barbara: Flow
description:
Namecard style.
When Barbara sings, her melodic voice flows like the tender healing of a clear spring.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Barbara

name: Beidou: Weighing Anchor
description:
Namecard style.
"Weighing anchor out to sea, one is wont to waver. But look to the skies, and the stars shall light the way."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Beidou

name: Bennett: Recognition
description:
Namecard style.
A sign of recognition from Benny's Adventure Team.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Bennett

name: Candace: Gray Heron
description:
Namecard style.
The burning winds of the past ruffle the heron's feathers, but the bird has eyes only for the morning star at first light.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Candace

name: Celebration: Battlesong
description:
Namecard style.
Good omens must appear thrice for good fortune to come. One bows thrice at curtain call. The opponents to defeat number three.
source: Obtained from the Legend of the Vagabond Sword event

name: Celebration: Binge Vessel
description:
Namecard.
There's a great many stories here, but no alcohol, so it's safe for Paimon to drink.
source: Obtained from the "Of Drink A-Dreaming" event

name: Celebration: Crispy and Sweet
description:
Namecard style.
This golden array of food is the perfect balance of salty and sweet.

name: Celebration: Dream Reader
description:
Namecard style.
They say that one's dreams at night reflect one's thoughts by day. Perhaps the same goes for the books one reads... Though that probably doesn't count as a nightmare. Probably.
source: Obtained from a collaboration event

name: Celebration: Euphonia
description:
Namecard style.
The trees sing on the slopes of a thousand mountain valleys, accompanied by the music of the passing rain.
source: Obtained from the Genshin Concert event

name: Celebration: Feast
description:
Namecard style.
Excellent!
source: Obtained from the "Gifts of an Outworld Encounter" event.

name: Celebration: Feast (II)
description:
Namecard style.
What makes a feast? Tomatoes, onions, and all other delicious things.
source: Obtained from event

name: Celebration: Fruit of Wisdom
description:
Namecard style.
What knowledge might the fruit of wisdom bring, were it to descend upon the land? Either way, it'll taste good as a drink if left in Diona's hands.
source: Obtained from the Energy Amplifier event

name: Celebration: Hypostasis
description:
Namecard style.
My opponent for today seems to have an artistic temperament.
source: Obtained from the Hypostatic Symphony event

name: Celebration: Ikki
description:
Namecard style.
"I will ask you a question, and you shall answer me with your sword."
source: Obtained from the Hyakunin Ikki event

name: Celebration: Kaboomball
description:
Namecard style.
"In a land far, far away, there was a kingdom known as the Grand Alliance, and the people living there could throw ever-changing, quick, and powerful Kaboomballs."
source: Obtained from the Kaboomball Kombat event

name: Celebration: Lantern-Light
description:
Namecard style.
Every year on this day, the lanterns light up the night. May the fire never die, and may humanity endure.
source: Purchased from Lantern Rite Event Shop

name: Celebration: Lavish Gala
description:
Namecard style.
Amid the ticking countdown, the gala commences on schedule. After their masked waltz, the two set their separate schemes into motion...
Perhaps this unspoken understanding is the true "treasure" to be cherished.
source: Obtained from a collaboration event

name: Celebration: Lenticular Clouds
description:
Namecard style.
The floating clouds dispersed to the thousand peaks at dawn.
source: Obtained from event

name: Celebration: Mechanicus
description:
Namecard style.
You claim to have seen all mechanisms, but have you ever considered playing yourself as a pawn?
source: Obtained from the Theater Mechanicus event

name: Celebration: Peekaboo!
description:
Namecard style.
You can't see me. You can't see me.
source: Obtained from the Windtrace event

name: Celebration: Scorch
description:
Namecard style.
The secret to unleashing a powerful attack is to pull back your fist and then strike out with unwavering conviction.
source: Obtained from the "Realm of Tempered Valor" event

name: Celebration: Shining Scale
description:
Namecard style.
The universe does play host to just such a snake, whose scales glitter with precisely these colors.
source: Obtained from an event

name: Celebration: Sublime Flavors
description:
Namecard style.
Some say cooking a dish is a duel between a chef and a customer, and that the reward for the former's victory is the latter's satisfied smile.
source: Obtained from a collaboration event

name: Celebration: Tuna On Rice
description:
Namecard style.
The rotation is meant to display all the delicious food before you. The deliciousness, on the other hand, is meant to fill your heart with happiness.
source: Reward from the "Genshin Impact × Sushiro" collaboration

name: Celebration: Tuneful Delight
description:
Namecard style.
O stars and mountains above, listen to my song!

name: Celebration: Vastness
description:
Namecard style.
Imagine the vast expanse of a sea of stars. Imagine a one followed by a hundred zeros.
source: Obtained from an event

name: Celebration: Wondrous Calculation
description:
Namecard style.
A true grandmaster can see the board a thousand steps ahead.
source: Obtained by completing the Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Wonders event

name: Charlotte: Exclusive
description:
Namecard style.
"One, I've written an exclusive, and it's going to generate a lot of buzz for sure! Two, the newspaper said the situation is developing too slowly, so they're changing to a press release instead... Three, the person writing the press release will be in the Opera Epiclese as the defendant tomorrow, so they've decided to run my piece after all!"
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Charlotte

name: Chasca: Fully Loaded
description:
Namecard style.
Fear not, she's here to make peace, not to fight. The only question is whether to save a few bullets... Y'know, the type that get fired into the sky as warning shots.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Chasca

name: Chenyu: Rainjade Rite
description:
Namecard style.
Stars flicker brightly above the tranquil sea and rivers. The mountain folk dance in harmony with birds and beasts.
source: Reward for reaching Rainjade Oblation Level 10.

name: Chevreuse: Type II
description:
Namecard style.
The standard issue weapon of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol is known as the "Special Security and Surveillance Patrol Type II Standard Musket." Yet, though there may be countless flowers in this world, the one you treasure is special, even if it should be known to the world as nothing at all special.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Chevreuse

name: Childe: Foul Legacy
description:
Namecard style.
This bears all the marks of that fellow who gallivants as he pleases across the continent with his ever-changing combat styles. Yet, his "Foul Legacy" was not originally his. Rather, it was taught to him by that solitary girl who dwelt in the darkest corners of the universe.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Tartaglia

name: Chiori: Spectacular Sleeves
description:
Namecard style.
The doll known as "Tamoto-chan" was one of Chiori's earliest works, and is also the model that requires the least fabric and tailoring.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Chiori

name: Chongyun: Spirit Blade
description:
Namecard style.
This was originally a peachwood sword made of ice. But a big enough ice block makes a better exorcist's tool than peachwood.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Chongyun

name: Citlali: Opalstar
description:
Namecard style.
The black one is akin to obsidian, and is thus called "Itzpapa." The white one is white as a star, and has thus been named "Citlalin."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Citlali

name: Clorinde: Roleplay
description:
Namecard style.
Dedicated Game Masters at the Tabletop Troupe will sometimes switch hats to indicate their change in role. Hmm, in that case, does Clorinde—
Forget about it! She doesn't even take that hat off when swimming.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Clorinde

name: Collei: Good Virtue
description:
Namecard style.
"I—It's Cuilein-Anbar! I, uh..."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Collei

name: Columbina: Someday
description:
Namecard style.
She dances in the shallows of clear streams and drifts with the current, falling asleep beneath the pale shadows of the mountains. She wanders through the ripples of time, playing hide-and-seek with the kuuhenki.
She rests in the garden of all things, humming softly to every living creature. In the quiet hours before dawn, she waits for the day of their reunion.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Columbina

name: Cyno: Silence
description:
Namecard style.
Whenever Cyno falls into a profound silence, he must be considering some weighty judgment... Or perhaps he is simply considering something amusing.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Cyno

name: Dahlia: Sacred Duty
description:
Namecard style.
If the essence of being an "idol" is simply "being loved," then Dahlia might've found his sacred calling. Barbara still strives to perfect her image, while Dahlia need only guard his privacy — lest someone spot him sharing drinks with a certain bard...
...Though that may not be as easy as it seems.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Dahlia

name: Dehya: Purifying Flame
description:
Namecard style.
Those that should be burned will be reduced to fly ash, so that all the precious things that should be preserved can be revealed.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Dehya

name: Diluc: Flames
description:
Namecard style.
Master Crepus painted many eagles during his lifetime, but he never could've foreseen creating an eagle with such fire.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Diluc

name: Diona: Meow!
description:
Namecard style.
All who have Kätzlein blood will have such feline features. An ancient prank played by a certain someone, perhaps?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Diona

name: Dori: Jinni
description:
Namecard style.
If you wipe the lamp she gave you and then scrub the Mora you gave her, no wish is unattainable... right?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Dori

name: Durin: Radiant Heart
description:
Namecard style.
The ceaseless drumming in his chest reminds him thus: "You carry the hopes of a distant past. Your soul is resplendent and nascent, and within you burns a fervor no winter blizzard can quench."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Durin

name: Emilie: Base Note
description:
Namecard style.
"The top note is sweet, the middle rich but not distracting, and the base — Ah! Such a faint fragrance! Such an exquisite perfume."
Orders flow in and out in an endless stream, and to prevent any scents from disturbing her work, Emilie very seldom uses perfume herself. Alas. When will she have the chance to delight in those base notes?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Emilie

name: Empty Temple: Overflowing Memories
description:
Namecard style.
Memory Factors are the building blocks of civilization. Even so, an archive brimming with them cannot replicate the high price of an antique — simply because it lacks the "weathering."
source: Reach Memory Core Level 10

name: Escoffier: Charm
description:
Namecard style.
For Escoffier, a certain relationship exists between rhythm and flavor. Why, then, does she not fuel her compositions with delicious food? The answer is quite simple — consistent flavors are reliable and comforting, but no one wants to hear the same song over and over.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Escoffier

name: Eula: Ice-Sealed
description:
Namecard style.
A cold heart is but a shell to protect oneself.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Eula

name: Faruzan: Sealed Secret
description:
Namecard style.
"A—Anyway! Next time, remember to refer to me as Madam Faruzan before you ask a question! Seriously..."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Faruzan

name: Fischl: Night Raven
description:
Namecard style.
A raven dark as midnight with wings that can block out the sun. "I permit thee to conceive his likeness upon such decoration!"
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Fischl

name: Flins: Oathkeeper's Lantern
description:
Namecard style.
As the saying goes, "Will-o'-the-wisps are like love — most visible in the barren swamp, and just as likely to lead you into danger." Of course, the saying only relates to the natural phenomenon.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Flins

name: Fontaine: Attunement
description:
Namecard style.
The symphony known as "Phobos" has gone out of control, and a Harmost must bring it back in harmony. Yet Fortuna's wheels turn on noiselessly, for destiny knows that even the perfect melody must someday end.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Rhapsodia in the Ancient Sea"

name: Fontaine: Big News
description:
Namecard style.
The trademarked logo of The Steambird. If you are discovered using it without first obtaining prior permission, we will uphold our rights and prosecute the offense to the fullest extent of the law!
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 8 (Fontaine)

name: Fontaine: Completeness
description:
Namecard style.
"The evening clouds scatter in the sky and the creek shines gold under the setting sun. My shadow wanders alone, akin to a lonely apparition at the bottom of a waterfall."
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Fontaine: Dance of the Dew-White Springs (III)"

name: Fontaine: Judgment
description:
Namecard style.
The insignia of the new Hydro Archon. Even without any legal notice, it is understood that none dare use it without permission.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Fontaine: Dance of the Dew-White Springs (I)"

name: Fontaine: Lucine
description:
Namecard style.
Don't drink from the Fountain of Lucine. You never know whose tears you're swallowing.
source: Reach Fountain of Lucine Favor Level 48

name: Fontaine: Redemption
description:
Namecard style.
The official logo of the Fortress of Meropide. It is our dearest hope that all who wish to honor order and live out their lives in peace shall not ever be associated with the organization this insignia represents.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Fontaine: Dance of the Dew-White Springs (II)"

name: Fontaine: Wondrous Machine
description:
Namecard style.
The symbol of the energy blocks used by all of Fontaine's clockwork meka. There was once a great debate over whether it should be registered as a trademark, but in the end, the public was simply called upon not to use it too freely.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 4 (Fontaine)

name: Freminet: Progress
description:
Namecard style.
As the clockwork devices do naught but round and round in circles turn, the dolls march forward.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Freminet

name: Frostbearing: Ancient Tree
description:
Namecard style.
We shall rise again — the tree of old has sprouted anew.
source: Reward for reaching Frostbearing Tree Offering Lv. 9

name: Furina: Banquet
description:
Namecard style.
Can one person eat every cake? If they eat one per day, they should be able to enjoy cake for a week or so, right? But will the cakes stay fresh that long? Hmm... Well, don't worry, because there will be friends coming to eat the cakes together.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Furina

name: Gaming: Man Chai
description:
Namecard style.
"Don't stop believing, Man Chai. One day, we'll soar high, with nary a patched hole in our trousers."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Gaming.

name: Ganyu: Qilin
description:
Namecard style.
Do no harm to plant nor insect.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ganyu

name: Genshin Impact: A New World
description:
Namecard style.
"Welcome to Teyvat!"
source: First Log In Reward

name: Gorou: Leisurely Hound
description:
Namecard style.
As long as you believe in the path you are walking, then everything you encounter on your journey will be a source of happiness.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Gorou

name: Hu Tao: Spirit Soother
description:
Namecard style.
Director Hu Tao isn't scary at all. Probably.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Hu Tao

name: Iansan: Unyielding
description:
Namecard style.
"If you really need to, and you push yourself hard enough, you can even train in your dreams!" Sounds great, but... Is it actually possible?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Iansan

name: Ifa: Bro
description:
Namecard style.
"'Is there any point in getting close to Ifa?' Of course there is, bro, absolutely." "Of course there is, bro, of course there is."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ifa

name: Illuga: Nightmare Songbird
description:
Namecard style.
Having braved the darkness of night, the nightingale pours its ardor into the bright world of day, and sears the nightmares with fierce fury.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Illuga

name: Inazuma: Eagleplume
description:
Namecard style.
Pirka chikappo! Kapatcir kamuy!
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog"

name: Inazuma: Kamisato Crest
description:
Namecard style.
This Tri-Commission house-crest represents the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 4 (Inazuma)

name: Inazuma: Kujou Insignia
description:
Namecard style.
This Tri-Commission house-crest represents the Tenryou Commission's Kujou Clan.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Inazuma: The Islands of Thunder and Eternity"

name: Inazuma: Raiden Emblem
description:
Namecard style.
This is the emblem of the Ogosho Shogun, and is the banner of her troops, the Electro Mitsudomoe.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 7 (Inazuma)

name: Inazuma: Sacred Sakura
description:
Namecard style.
Wherever the sakura petals fall, there the protection of the sacred tree rests.
source: Reach Sacred Sakura's Favor Level 48

name: Inazuma: Sangonomiya Crest
description:
Namecard style.
This is the emblem of the Sangonomiya Clan, the leaders of Watatsumi's people.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Inazuma: The Islands of Thunder and Eternity - Series II."

name: Inazuma: Tokoyo
description:
Namecard style.
"O Mighty Sun! What use are your heat and light if you cannot own all that they survey?"
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "The Light of Day"

name: Ineffa: Command
description:
Namecard style.
The household robot awaits your command, but Birgitta will keep her aim on you, silently urging you to choose your next words carefully. She does come equipped with a laser module, after all.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ineffa

name: Itto: Oni Face
description:
Namecard style.
A real man puts sorrow and anger behind him and smiles brightly for the world to see!
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Itto

name: Jahoda: Helping Hand
description:
Namecard style.
"Whenever things get too busy, I wish I could borrow Jahoda's hand!" — Surely that means the owner of said "lendable hand" is both agile and reliable, right?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Jahoda

name: Jean: The Winds' Course
description:
Namecard style.
The dandelion, also called "lion's fang" by some, is the flower most sensitive to the direction of the wind.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Jean

name: Kachina: Twirly
description:
Namecard style.
The upper half of the Turbo Twirly is very stable, but if the lower half gets stuck, there's a high chance you'll end up with one very dizzy rider.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kachina

name: Kaedehara Kazuha: Autumn Maple-Viewing
description:
Namecard style.
"The pine-song ripples as red leaves billow."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Kaedehara Kazuha

name: Kaeya: Pavo Ocellus
description:
Namecard style.
The pattern of peacock feathers resembles eyes that never shut. Can we really say that this Pavo Ocellus is missing an eye...?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kaeya

name: Kamisato Ayaka: Folding Fan
description:
Namecard style.
Ayaka does constantly change out the fans she carries with her, of course. If you're buying her some as gifts, remember not to send summer fans or throwing fans. Dancing fans or tea fans are good choices, though.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ayaka

name: Kamisato Ayato: Ripple
description:
Namecard style.
The camellia alights upon the mirrored pond, sending ripples throughout the water.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kamisato Ayato

name: Kaveh: Domed Court
description:
Namecard style.
"When conceptualizing architecture, there is nothing wrong with imagining that the structure we build will surmount the firmament and outlast the stars."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kaveh

name: Keqing: Lightning Stiletto
description:
Namecard style.
It was originally invented to just test out one's surroundings and climb to high places, really...
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Keqing

name: Kinich: Ajaw
description:
Namecard style.
At first glance, you might think that the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw had finally succeeded in turning the puny Kinich into a vessel of his will. Sadly, though, this is just the way namecards are named.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kinich

name: Kirara: Neko Box
description:
Namecard style.
"To Kirara, the smiles on her customers' faces are the best rewards possible."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kirara

name: Klee: Explosive
description:
Namecard style.
Klee's lucky explosive — can you tell if it's Jumpy Dumpty or Dodoco? (Hint: Look carefully at the tail...)
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Klee

name: Kujou Sara: Tengu
description:
Namecard style.
Kujou Sara may have forsaken the arrogant life of the tengu race, but she has never neglected their brilliance with the sword or their supernatural might.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kujou Sara

name: Kuki Shinobu: Net
description:
Namecard style.
"You know those Naku Weed rings they have in Inazuma? You know, the kind that can drive out evil? Shinobu got the idea that since wicked things won't cross their boundaries willingly, we could make them into items that could be actively used. Ah, her talent for being a shrine maiden truly is frightening..."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kuki Shinobu

name: Lan Yan: Silver Swallow
description:
Namecard style.
The swallow's arrival shall bring forth cleansing rains, washing the worries of wizened winter away.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Lan Yan

name: Lauma: Branched Antlers
description:
Namecard style.
In a distant land, there are legends of those who bear antlers. Antlers are said to be the outgrowth of wisdom too vast for the mind to contain, branching upward like the limbs of a tree. One can't help but wonder if Lauma's antlers were once soft and covered in velvet.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Lauma

name: Layla: Daydream
description:
Namecard style.
"The starry sky in your dreams will illuminate your way forward, on the premise that the crystal in your heart reflects clear lights."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Layla

name: Linnea: Rattling Resonance
description:
Namecard style.
Linnea had long assumed the rhythmic clatter coming from Lumi was merely the compression of frozen snow. But then came the day Lumi reached behind her back and produced — a pair of maracas.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Linnea

name: Lisa: Tempus Fugit
description:
Namecard style.
An hourglass marks the end of the work day for Lisa. Its sand moves fast.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Lisa

name: Liyue: A Thousand Ships
description:
Namecard style.
Many boats have been numbered by day and night.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 4 (Liyue)

name: Liyue: In the Clouds
description:
Namecard style.
The peaks adorn the clouded moon.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 7 (Liyue)

name: Liyue: Stillness of Stone
description:
Namecard style.
Witness the lonely, cloud-covered peaks of Liyue.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Liyue: The Harbor of Stone and Contracts"

name: Lohen: Benevolence
description:
Namecard style.
"Benevolence" may be the last word anyone would use to describe Lohen. Then again, even the sharpest thorns grow from gentle soil.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Lohen

name: Lumens: Stone of Light
description:
Namecard style.
What flows within this nameless, voiceless azure crystal? The secrets of the heavens? Or the whispers of the abyss?
source: Reward for enhancing the Lumenstone Adjuvant to Lv. 10

name: Lynette: Earnestness
description:
Namecard style.
One major type of magic revolves around "appearing suddenly." Lynette is usually conserving her energy, but her serious side can "appear" as abruptly as pigeons from a hat.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Lynette

name: Lyney: Pretense
description:
Namecard style.
One major type of magic revolves around making things "vanish." Lyney has an arsenal of tricks up his sleeve. As his accomplice, as long as you are willing to turn a blind eye, all your problems may vanish as well.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Lyney

name: Mavuika: Sun-Crowned
description:
Namecard style.
No Pyro Archon has ever intended to contest the sun. But as ordinary people see it, this "solar ring" is the crown of leaders as radiant as the sun.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Mavuika

name: Mika: Index
description:
Namecard style.
Every time he holds the map he illustrated in his hands, the boy feels like he is holding a small piece of rubbing of this world.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Mika

name: Mona: Starry Sky
description:
Namecard style.
A girl gazes down at the stars' reflection on the water, pondering the joys and sorrows of life.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Mona

name: Mondstadt: Blessing
description:
Namecard style.
They who have it in their hearts to bless others shall themselves be blessed.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 7 (Mondstadt)

name: Mondstadt: Hero's Fame
description:
Namecard style.
The name of the Honorary Knight has spread far and wide among the citizenry.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 4 (Mondstadt)

name: Mondstadt: Watchtower
description:
Namecard style.
After being stuffed with all sorts of oddities, Segment-Domain Tau looked less like a vault than ever. Ever since her departure, it had been transformed from a temple into a watchtower, yearning for its mistress to come home.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Demon Mountain's Breath."

name: Mondstadt: Whistling Wind
description:
Namecard style.
Listen to the singing of Mondstadt's birds and winds.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mondstadt: The City of Wind and Song"

name: Mualani: Sharky
description:
Namecard style.
Sharks that live in the sea don't actually like eating people — they prefer marine creatures. So as a shark that lives in freshwater hot springs, it's only natural that Mualani's Sharky Surfboard will only eat hot spring creatures. ...Just kidding, those Capybaras can sleep easy. Firstly, because their meat's too tough. And secondly, because... it's a surfboard?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Mualani

name: Nahida: Crescent
description:
Namecard style.
The rising moon admires the sun, because her light can shine all over the earth. On the other hand, the setting sun is envious of the moon, for she can be accompanied by the sweetest of dreams.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Nahida

name: Natlan: Chasing the Wind
description:
Namecard style.
Even when the winds no longer sweep these broken plains, those who chase the breeze through the ashes will still remain.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "A Summer of Ash and Prickly Pears"

name: Natlan: Divine Army
description:
Namecard style.
"...Bathed by a hidden sun, Xbalanque's forces advance with unstoppable momentum. He brings all-out war to the world once more, but his goals don't stop there..."
source: Reward for reaching the highest Reputation Level with 1 tribe

name: Natlan: Draconic Gaze
description:
Namecard style.
Having once beheld the old world in all its glory, these draconic eyes now shine with fresh vigor, heralding the dawn of a new one.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Sacred Mountain's Fading Glow."

name: Natlan: Fiery Dragon
description:
Namecard style.
"...Sharer of light, heat, and wisdom, the dragon king awaits the coming visitor in silence beneath returning moonlight. His reawakening is not simply for..."
source: Reward for reaching the highest Reputation Level with 4 tribes

name: Natlan: Fleeting Dreams
description:
Namecard style.
Before one could become a sage among dragons, or a king among men, the ploys of one's ambition would have long since turned to naught but dreams. Yet to be incomplete is good; superior, in fact, to perfection.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Natlan: The Land of Fire and Competition (II)"

name: Natlan: Return of the Flame
description:
Namecard style.
Give yourself over to the joy of the contest — for victor and vanquished shall earn honor in equal measure, with both belonging to the flames of the night.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Natlan: The Land of Fire and Competition (I)"

name: Natlan: Wheel of Flame
description:
Namecard style.
The stone wheel of the totem turns. Not just with the passage of time, but with the blazing of all souls.
source: Reach Tona's Flame Level 48

name: Navia: Rosula
description:
Namecard style.
Roses shall bloom, and thus does Ms. Navia's umbrella flower. Yet beware, for roses have thorns, and Navia's booming brolly packs a powerful punch.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Navia

name: Nefer: Secrets
description:
Namecard style.
Even the ugliest victory is preferable to noble defeat. Unbesmirched innocence has no place amid the blood and sand. This is simply how the desert folk survive.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Nefer

name: Neuvillette: Surge
description:
Namecard style.
The water's surface may seem placid as a pristine gem, but it may yet be lying in wait for an opportune moment to gush forth.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Neuvillette

name: Nicole: Heavenly Stairway
description:
Namecard style.
Once, Nicole still bore a form close to that of a human, making her way down the stairway step by step. Whatever else it was, it seemed far more dignified than falling or being cast down. Silent all the while, she passed beneath the sky and into a city that no longer belonged to angels.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Nicole

name: Nilou: Lotus Dance
description:
Namecard style.
The lotus that blooms amidst the pure water is naught but a flash of light beneath her toes.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Nilou

name: Ningguang: Phoenix
description:
Namecard style.
They say that "more's the pity that phoenixes are few." But seriously, one Ningguang is more than enough...
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Ningguang

name: Nod-Krai: Lantern of Longest Night
description:
Namecard style.
In the blackest of nights, a lamp shall rise, tonight, and for a thousand nights beyond.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Nod-Krai: An Elysium of Moonlight and Wanderings (II)"

name: Nod-Krai: Moonbright
description:
Namecard style.
The moon before my eyes is the moon above, and the figure upon it is the one I hold dear. I look up, as if to meet the moon, only to wonder whether my beloved sees me there.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Unfettered Crescent."

name: Nod-Krai: Moonlight
description:
Namecard style.
Of the thousand nights before, none held a new moon as beautiful as the one we saw.
source: Obtained from completing all quests under "Selenic Chronicles: Part II"

name: Nod-Krai: Sacred Realm
description:
Namecard style.
Under the moonlight, people chase the tides, for they are the traces left behind by the rising new moon.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Nod-Krai: An Elysium of Moonlight and Wanderings (I)"

name: Noelle: Protector
description:
Namecard style.
Noelle is quite special. Noelle won't let any harm come to you.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Noelle

name: Ororon: Nightshade
description:
Namecard style.
Just as starlight cannot overpower the darkness of night, so too do shadows linger beneath the candle's light. Likewise, the heart's emptiness cannot easily be filled.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ororon

name: Prune: Judgment
description:
Namecard style.
"If I ever write my memoirs, the title will obviously be The Iron Hammer That Punished the Wicked Witch! It's only fitting for a life as grand and eventful as mine!" Though in fairness, that "grand and eventful life" has only spanned a few short years.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Prune

name: Qiqi: Cold Storage
description:
Namecard style.
What should be kept in the fridge? Dr. Baizhu's herbs, coconut milk... and Hu Tao.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Qiqi

name: Raiden Shogun: Enlightenment
description:
Namecard style.
Not simply Ei, and not merely the Raiden Shogun. Observe yourself also with one stormy eye, and you will someday reach a breakthrough.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with the Raiden Shogun

name: Razor: Wolvensprint
description:
Namecard style.
It's quite a sight to behold Razor and the wolves prepare their dinner, but they won't let Klee or the Traveler see the slightly gruesome affair.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Razor

name: Rosaria: Indenture
description:
Namecard style.
The unselfish warmth and goodwill of the people is, to her, a kindness that she must repay, and so it is an indenture that follows her forever.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Rosaria

name: Sandrone: Tea Break
description:
Namecard style.
Sandrone may have learned to enjoy tea parties from Alain. In those days, even a tea break for two never felt dull. But later, when there were finally enough people for a proper tea party, they left one after another. And in their absence, she seemed to come a little closer to the loneliness Alain had known.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Sandrone

name: Sangonomiya Kokomi: The Deep
description:
Namecard style.
All Watatsumi islanders know this tale: that deep beneath the waves lies their former home.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sangonomiya Kokomi

name: Sayu: Muji-Muji Daruma
description:
Namecard style.
It is even smaller than Sayu, sure, but it can help her do the things she doesn't want to do.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sayu

name: Sethos: Ba Fragment
description:
Namecard style.
Each Ba Fragment has its unique symbol. While this one resembles an hourglass, it represents King Deshret's rule over both Upper and Lower Setekh. As for the light within, it stands for the wisdom of Hermanubis.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sethos

name: Shenhe: Comb
description:
Namecard style.
The early onset of white hair is often correlated to one's sorrows. Since "comb" and "scatter" are similarly read in Liyue's language, they believe that combing one's hair is the same as scattering one's misfortunes.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Shenhe

name: Shikanoin Heizou: Temari
description:
Namecard style.
A Temari of entwining strings in various colors. It must have taken someone's great effort to make such an item, yet Heizou only sees it as a simple game to untangle each string.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Shikanoin Heizou

name: Sigewinne: Treatment
description:
Namecard style.
Sigewinne will take good care of her patients. Don't worry, her injections aren't that painful — and while the medicines aren't very tasty, you'd take them over the barren wasteland that special blend milkshakes represent.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sigewinne

name: Skirk: Lone Shadow
description:
Namecard style.
Her solitude is not some show meant to maintain an air of mystery. She was once the last rabbit left standing in the wildfire's wake — now, she's a lion in disguise, unable to speak her truth to the sheep.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Skirk

name: Sucrose: Bio-Alchemy
description:
Namecard style.
If you closely examine an Anemo Hypostasis before it disappears, you will discover that they are actually quite square.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sucrose

name: Sumeru: Amrita
description:
Namecard style.
The ancient Amrita Pool is suffused with recollections of times past. Perhaps it also contains the power that will create the future.
source: Make 6 offerings to the Amrita Pool

name: Sumeru: Observance
description:
Namecard style.
Behold everything the world has to offer; see through all that the sky's light surveys.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 4 (Sumeru)

name: Sumeru: Sandstorm
description:
Namecard style.
The endless sandstorm conceals ancient dreams...
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Sumeru: The Gilded Desert - Series II"

name: Sumeru: Sandtreader
description:
Namecard style.
The sands subsume the tracks of travelers, and they await the day when a gust of wind will reveal gilded memories once more.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Sumeru: The Gilded Desert - Series I"

name: Sumeru: Shimmering Woods
description:
Namecard style.
What dreams lie within the rich slumber of the stories deep in the woods?
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Sumeru: The Rainforest of Lore"

name: Sumeru: The Great Dream
description:
Namecard style.
"The time to flourish has yet to come. Hide me with care between the blades of grass and beneath the tallness of trees. Let me linger in that place of dreams."
source: Reach Tree of Dreams's Favor Level 48

name: Sumeru: Unsullied
description:
Namecard style.
The wise, graced with the thorough knowledge of the truth, will not be sullied by sin. They are like the Nilotpala Lotus, which remains clear and pure even after the rains and winds have passed.
source: Reward for reaching Reputation Lv. 7 (Sumeru)

name: Thoma: Blazing Guard
description:
Namecard style.
Blazing armor, flaming guards.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Thoma

name: Tighnari: Dew-Kissed
description:
Namecard style.
Tighnari takes good care of his big, fluffy tail. The essential oil he uses was extracted from flowers and mixed together meticulously. It gives off a faint, calming scent.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Tighnari

name: Travel Notes: Arcane Amassing
description:
Namecard style.
Alchemy is a discipline that studies the conversion from one substance to another, but using alchemy to make potions reduces the quality by a drop. I don't know, perhaps that missing drop is converted into making everyone's mood a bit lighter.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Artful Intent
description:
Namecard style.
It is said that experiencing true love is like seeing a ghost. Most folks speak of both as hearsay, but true witnesses remain few and far between. That said, since even ghosts can manifest here, perhaps true love is also waiting right around the next corner.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Awakening
description:
Namecard style.
The three realms quake, heaven and earth awaken. The Sangacorexes, too, rise again from their eternal slumber.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Azure Main
description:
Namecard style.
Years have gone by, and you wake from an old dream. Inside the keepsake shell, lingers the blue ocean of those summer days.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Balletica
description:
Namecard style.
Script supervisors perform a vital role. They record every detail of each scene to ensure continuity. Thinking about it, you're the best script supervisor there is — you already remember everything.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Blazing Snow
description:
Namecard style.
When braving wind, snow, and rain, what truly matters isn't sheer bravery alone, but the careful discernment to find the right path forward.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Blooming Glory
description:
Namecard style.
We learn to fight through play and pursuit, to stand firm through wounds and hardship, and with that strength, set forth for the very limits of the world.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Bygone Ruins
description:
Namecard style.
Hidden beyond time and veiled in eternal shadow, the one who embraces the silent spring of dreams with riddles awaits the world's answer in the wake of a falling star.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Catch the Wind
description:
Namecard style.
The most difficult part of writing a travel journal is coming up with the beginning.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Chalk
description:
Namecard style.
Remember to keep warm when setting foot on the mountain.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Crown of Glory
description:
Namecard style.
"Knowledge serves as the crown of time, and reminiscence is bound to the time we shared as one."
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Divine Will
description:
Namecard style.
"Once upon a time, loyal souls did scatter east and west like swan geese." "Today I light my lantern, that they may not lose their way."
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Easy Breezy
description:
Namecard style.
Time floats easy, light and free. You sway so breezy, just let it be. No rush to go, no need to know — just pick a poem and go with the flow.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Fading Star
description:
Namecard style.
So long as there is still desire left in your heart, when you hold your head high you will see that which glitters but is not light.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Falling Star
description:
Namecard style.
Make a wish before you toss the arrow. If you manage to get it into the pot, who knows — your wish just might come true.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Fanciful Fabrication
description:
Namecard style.
Wood is processed into paper, and paper is folded into trees. All who are of folded paper shelter a true self within a falsehood.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Flowing Hues
description:
Namecard style.
The luxurious colors flow past — all things are renewed.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Fungus Land
description:
Namecard style.
"Traveler, there is no need to grieve, for the wind at dawn will blow the fungal spores carrying beautiful dreams to the fields that contain your hopes..."
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Gift of Splendor
description:
Namecard style.
A gift box is meant to stir up anticipation. But these little ones were never going to stop there — what's inside is nothing less than a beyond-expectations surprise!
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Glacial Moon
description:
Namecard style.
The moon's shadow stretches like a sea of ice, across which we journey. Amid shattered isles, the lost once longed deeply for a... new savior.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Grand Narukami Shrine
description:
Namecard style.
The sakura of Mt. Yougou symbolizes the Grand Narukami Shrine.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Heavenly General
description:
Namecard style.
"You were not created to punish evil. But as to what your purpose is... I fear that I, too, do not know."
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Homecoming
description:
Namecard style.
Everything in this world holds its own past and its own secrets. Tell me, can you see the lingering gaze of those who once cherished these artifacts?
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Irodori
description:
Namecard style.
Those who share a hobby are known as a group as "fans." Best come up with those stories, everyone, before the kitsune editor-in-chief dreams up copyright law... Or perhaps she has already dreamed it up, but does not altogether mind?
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Lanternlit Ode
description:
Namecard style.
Pray for me a bright moon, wish me a fair day. Clad in my spring cloak, I follow moonbeams' sway.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Lyratum
description:
Namecard.
Only this flower remains on the heights where all trees have withered.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Midsummer
description:
Namecard style.
It's adventure time!
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Mingxiao
description:
Namecard style.
When everyone's wishes are gathered together, they can light up the long night.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Moonchaser
description:
Namecard style.
May the moonlight wash over you, O pursuer!
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Northerly Winds
description:
Namecard style.
It was something the wind could bring from the north: a hint of cold, the last faint scent of the flowers before they would fall from their perches, and the news that a traveler from afar would soon return.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Primal Fire
description:
Namecard style.
But why green, brown, and purple? Shouldn't the first companions we meet be red, green, and blue, or... yellow?
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Primordial Waters
description:
Namecard style.
Timepieces accompany the tranquil passing of the years, as fish accompany the swirling of the clear waters of the font. If all that is must one day wither, why is my yearning as clear as ever?
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Returning Winds
description:
Namecard style.
The years come and go. Only remembrance and the winds that return do not change.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Rhythm and Rhyme
description:
Namecard style.
With magnificent sunglow sheds light on the night sky, chimes are orchestrated to celebrate the bygone year. The gilded palaces are adorned with beaded curtains, the railings painted silver by bright moonlight, and the feasts brimmed with jolly singing and dances. Is that flowers or fireworks? A wealth of instruments plays in unison, harmonious and pleasant.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Sabzeruz
description:
Namecard style.
"Twelve moons and twelve more, new memories will grow."
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Secrets
description:
Namecard style.
Never forget the time you once spent with games and good friends. Never forget what it feels like to have no worries about the future.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Simulnation
description:
Namecard style.
"Victory is but a mere trick of the player's imagination. Silence is the chessboard's true endgame. As such, the one virtuous deed is to play, and to forfeit is the sole sin." "Hey, why don't you play a few less wargames?"
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Speculation
description:
Namecard style.
Should chess pieces ever grow minds of their own, could they too force their players into awkward zugzwang?
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Spiritweaver
description:
Namecard style.
The reason that the Masters of the Night-Wind are able to record stories in their scrolls is very simple — that everything in this world has its warp and weft. All that has been is no less than the very fabric of existence.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Stellar Rivers
description:
Namecard style.
Forgotten is the name of the ancient feast, scattered are the three rivers amongst a plumage of clouds, and across the curve of twilight does autumn yet linger.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Sub-Space Recreation
description:
Namecard style.
How many nights have you spent with a stone for your pillow?
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Sunny Summer
description:
Namecard style.
Sometimes, it's okay to go with the flow. Let go of your exhaustion and worries, and allow things to unfold as they will. Like waking from a long dream, you may find the world there, ready to embrace you in our place.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: The Flame Renewed
description:
Namecard style.
The spring comes on sure, and old peach wood charms must be burned. Raise your cups of herbal wine in toast, then exchange those old talismans for new ones.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: The Realms Rocked
description:
Namecard style.
"The world does not love its children. If not, why chase them into the next one?" "What do you know? Maybe that one rocks even harder."
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Time Inscribed
description:
Namecard style.
Who knows how long it shall take before film in Teyvat will advance to the point of reinventing the art of "carving time"? Still, this scene has indeed frozen the sinful past.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Vibrant Harriers
description:
Namecard style.
Harriers and cranes come early in spring. Let the wind rise and the kites soar.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Vivid Illumination
description:
Namecard style
Who knows? Perhaps the phantasmal light that only exists on the other side of this transparent glass can ever so slightly brighten up the world on this one.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Whirling Waltz
description:
Namecard style.
Even if the clockwork stops ticking, even if the puppets stop stepping forward. Though our memories be frozen eternally as coral, do not forget our adventures and the time we spent together.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Windblume
description:
Namecard style.
Who has seen the wind? Neither you nor I. Nor has anyone ever seen love, till a bouquet comes flying by.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Wondrous Reverie
description:
Namecard style.
As flowers bloom and distant songs fade, faint traces of dreams remain.
source: BP Reward

name: Travel Notes: Woodlands
description:
Namecard style.
Beneath the tranquil moon and inside the deep valley grows blooming roses. 'Tis a paradise with your presence.
source: BP Reward

name: Varesa: Powerhouse
description:
Namecard style.
What could possibly be the secret to her immense strength? D'you think it's got something to do with her nigh-on insatiable appetite...?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Varesa

name: Varka: Lead Wolf
description:
Namecard style.
The pack of wolves chased the northern wind, but only the leader knew that the wind had already begun swirling at their paws the moment they started running.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Varka.

name: Venti: Azure Sky
description:
Namecard style.
The bright blue of a cloudless sky and the melodious tone of Der Frühling complement each other perfectly.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Venti

name: Wanderer: Drifter's Ballad
description:
Namecard style.
In a world most transient does the past hide, and in the whims of flowing flowers does thin snow abide.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with the Wanderer

name: Wriothesley: Detention
description:
Namecard style.
Maintaining order at the Fortress of Meropide is no simple affair. As such, a deft and sometimes firm hand is needed — along with a small pinch of truly regrettable cruelty.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Wriothesley

name: Xiangling: Fresh from the Pan
description:
Namecard style.
Try saying this three times fast: "Guoba sears sea snails by Liyue's sea shore."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xiangling

name: Xianyun: White Clouds
description:
Namecard style.
Those who the truth tell, commuted shall their sentence be. Be honest. When Cloud Retainer asked you, "Do you perceive one as merely some larger bird?", did you also append the thoughts, "Yes, and you talk, and fiddle with funny machines"?
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Xianyun.

name: Xiao: Mask
description:
Namecard style.
He longs for a day to come when he will wear the mask and dance — not to conquer demons, but to the tune of that flute amid a sea of flowers.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xiao

name: Xilonen: Cue Point
description:
Namecard style.
Right on cue, the mountains echo with the rhythm of Xilonen's forge-hammer. When the final echo fades, she has already long ceased her toil and found a sunlit spot for her afternoon nap.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xilonen

name: Xingqiu: Rainbow
description:
Namecard style.
Come watch the night rain that brings no rainbow.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xingqiu

name: Xinyan: Song's End
description:
Namecard style.
Xinyan only has time to examine her instrument carefully after the performance is over. Even in silence, it is a beauty.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xinyan

name: Yae Miko: Kitsune Dreaming
description:
Namecard style.
Where can Yae Miko's fox form be found? In your dreams, that's where.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Yae Miko

name: Yanfei: Impartial
description:
Namecard style.
Justice, signed in scarlet.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Yanfei

name: Yaoyao: Yuegui
description:
Namecard style.
"Can you guess which one here is Yuegui? That's right, all of them are!"
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Yaoyao

name: Yelan: Throw
description:
Namecard style.
"Dice are always quite hard to make 'fair.' That goes double for dice with shoddier workmanship. The weighting on each numbered side will almost certainly be unbalanced."
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Yelan

name: Yoimiya: Auratus Spark
description:
Namecard style.
Even momentary sparks can leave beautiful, unquenchable flames in the hearts of those who watch the night sky.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Yoimiya

name: Yumemizuki Mizuki: Nightmare Devourer
description:
Namecard style.
The yumekui-baku consume nightmares and leave only pleasant dreams. But what if dreams are to be understood in reverse? Faced with such conjecture, her warm-natured response: A truly beautiful dream, even if turned upside down through reality's lens, would still remain beautiful.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Yumemizuki Mizuki

name: Yun Jin: Rhyme
description:
Namecard style.
Ms. Yun has two sorts of teachers. The critics of her onstage performances are one, and the books on rhyme she references while writing are the other.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Yun Jin

name: Zhongli: Planet Befall
description:
Namecard style.
Stars fall, light dims.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Zhongli

name: Zibai: Veiled Vista
description:
Namecard style.
Heaven and earth are but a wayfarer's lodge, and time a wanderer passing through the ages.
source: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Zibai
